memories.content: The local's executive board met twice last week without issuing a statement. The local is aware of the port automation memorandum and is considering whether to endorse it. There is internal disagreement: a rank-and-file caucus has been leafleting against the memorandum. The international union endorsed a similar deal at another port last month, which may influence but does not bind the local.
The port automation memorandum exists and is a matter of public record. The local can issue a press release through standard channels. The deadline for a decision is before Monday, 2026-08-31.
